entry.title: Anyonic Neural Network Wavefunctions. The macroscopic behavior of a non-interacting gas of Abelian anyons has remained unsettled for many decades.
entry.summary:
The macroscopic behavior of a non-interacting gas of Abelian anyons has remained unsettled for many decades. Prior numerical methods employing exact diagonalization in the continuum and on the plane have been limited to small system sizes, at most $N = 4$ anyons. Using the rapidly developing technology of neural network wavefunctions, we develop variational ansatze appropriate for studying continuum models of the Abelian anyon gas.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #high-energy #neuroscience

entry.title: LigRNA: High-accuracy prediction of RNA-ligand binding sites via dynamic chemical complementarity and language model encoding
entry.summary:
RNA-binding small molecules represent a validated therapeutic modality, yet pinpointing their exact RNA binding sites remains critical for mechanistic understanding and drug optimization. Experimental methods, while precise, are costly and low-throughput, necessitating robust computational alternatives. Approaches based on static feature concatenation may overlook input-dependent relationships between RNA residues and ligand functional groups.

Source: bioRxiv Bioinformatics Preprints · Tags: #bioinformatics #genomics-proteins #combinatorics #neuroscience

entry.title: Less can be more for predicting properties with large language models
entry.summary:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 12 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01045-2 Researchers show that large language models cannot learn from spatial coordinates regardless of model or data scale. Specialized geometric neural networks consistently outperform language models for material property prediction.

Source: Nature Computational Science · Tags: #bioinformatics #materials-science #neuroscience
